slides.heading: Get checked promptly if you notice

caption:
Desk all week, golf all weekend, and Toto's swing just isn't turning like it used to.

Golf, tennis, cricket and paddling all rely on rotation, and the mid-back between your shoulder blades is built to provide a good chunk of it. After long desk days it often stiffens, and the lower back and shoulders pick up the slack.

Try the quick check: sit, cross your arms and turn each way. Then open books and thread-the-needle, eight slow reps most days. An adjustment can help it feel looser short term, and the change tends to hold better with regular movement and strength work.

Chest pain, breathlessness, fever or pain after a fall needs prompt medical review. Our chiropractors at Hybrid Physio can help. Book online via the link in bio.
